title: A letter to you ✉️
lines: Today you step into your 20's, and I wanted to be one of the people who celebrates it properly.
Thank you for every memory, every laugh, and every lesson we shared.
I am proud of who you are becoming.
Whatever this year brings, I hope it brings you peace, love and everything you dream of.
I'll be honest with you, because you deserve honesty: I still care deeply.
So I have two questions. Answer only with your heart. No pressure.
